clinician.trajectory_summary: A six-year-old male initially presented with progressive left leg pain and inability to ambulate without initial radiographic abnormalities. Over months, repeat radiograph revealed an ill-defined lytic lesion with probable pathologic fracture in the proximal left femoral diaphysis (E001). Orthopedic surgery recommended MRI to characterize the lesion, but detailed MRI findings were not reported (E004). A biopsy of the lesion was performed revealing benign-appearing cystic tissue (E005), and the final pathology confirmed the diagnosis of an aneurysmal bone cyst (E007).
